designationHistory.indexText: Crocodile Lake National Wildlife Refuge on north Key Largo was established to protect critical habitat for the American crocodile.

authority.citation: Endangered Species Act of 1973; Land and Water Conservation Fund Act; Fish and Wildlife Act of 1956

designationHistory.note: FWS only; month and year only.
